handoffs.scientific_finding: Scientific continuity is a first-class system requirement: the mission must survive loss of conversational context.
evidence: Existing distributed scientific artifacts requiring reconciliation
handoffs.exact_requirement: Persist machine-readable identity, master state, claims, requirements, capabilities, negative knowledge, validation limits, handoffs and adversarial tests with stable IDs and explicit state transitions.
handoffs.expected_runtime_behaviour: A fresh ESPÍA bootstrap loads and validates canonical scientific state before selecting a next action.
handoffs.failure_condition: Fresh instance cannot reconstruct role, active question, evidence limits, current capability status, unresolved frontier and next action from repository state.
handoffs.validation_criterion: Automated bootstrap test returns a complete recovery object and rejects missing mandatory artifacts or malformed state.
handoffs.implementation_consequence: Add stdlib-only continuity loader/validator and canonical repository artifacts.
handoffs.unresolved_uncertainty: Completeness of historical scientific migration is not yet demonstrated.
handoffs.falsification_condition: A fresh recovery run demonstrably requires unavailable conversational context or reconstructs a materially false scientific state.
